products.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash

products.name: Grok 4.7
products.claim: Official API documentation labels Grok4.7 Latest; release notes confirm public API availability.

products.name: Kimi K3
products.claim: Official model table identifies K3 flagship; membership and context conditions apply. Moving aliases are not model identity.

products.name: MiniMax-M3
products.claim: Official current M3 product page supplies an exact API model example. Predecessors are not declared retired.

products.name: MiMo-V2.6-Pro

products.name: MiMo-V2.6-Flash
products.claim: Official September22 release confirms Open Platform launch of Flash.

products.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
products.claim: Official model documentation identifies the stable Flash version. Restricted Argon is deliberately excluded.

products.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
